title: audio_db playlist functions return raw tuples
description: audio_db.rs functions get_audio_playlist, list_audio_playlists, list_user_audio_playlists, and list_albums return bare tuples like Option<(i64, i64, String, String, String, i64)> instead of named structs. This forces callers to use positional indexing (.0, .1, etc.) which is fragile -- reordering columns silently breaks callers at runtime. All other entity types in the DB layer (TrackRow, AudioChannelRow, PodcastSeriesRow, BookRow, ReviewRow, etc.) correctly use named structs. The tuple approach also means callers can't grep for field names or get IDE completion.
close_reason: Deferred: converting playlist tuple returns to named structs requires updating all 3 servers' funkwhale handlers. Tracked for next refactor pass.
